scope: C3 CO11 horizontal cross-track 2D proxy and MT33 variable-offset 2D gather, D10 box vs matched BG; development diagnostics only
prohibited_interpretations: retention is not a detection score
no candidate ranking or passing threshold
prearrival/late windows not certified target-free after band limitation
no G4 relief, training, S5 rerun or FDTD
units: source-normalised ideal field response; unweighted discrete L2 on common saved grid, not calibrated physical energy
operator_definition: identity: T(X)=X; trace_mean_removal: T(X)[t,j]=X[t,j]-mean_j(X[t,j]) using complex values across the full gather at each time
operator_application: whole gather before windowing; trace mean taken at each time sample independently, complex values retained
pair_definition: E0=matched BG complex_envelope; E1=D10 TGT complex_envelope; delta=E1-E0 before operator application
window_rule: half-open [start_s,stop_s), compared on saved physical time_s without rounding to old FDTD indices

provenance.contract_encoding: UTF-8; hash covers unchanged raw bytes
